summary: Tapping the Like heart (dark mode) plays X's classic heart burst. The gray outline heart is swapped instantly for a small pink dot. The dot grows into a 28 pt disc that shifts from crimson to lavender, its center hollows out into a thin ring, and the pink heart pops up inside it. At the same time 7 pairs of pastel dots fly outward and fade. The heart then dips to about 0.89x and eases back to 1.0, about 880 ms after the tap. Unliking skips the burst: the gray outline jumps to about 1.58x, holds briefly, then shrinks back to 1.0x. The count swaps instantly, with no number roll.
trigger: Single tap on the heart in the tweet action row (feed and post detail). The state change and the count swap happen on the first visible frame.

interactions.label: Tap Repost on tweet 2 (feed): Repost/Quote/React with Video sheet slides up
Dismiss repost sheet (tap outside), no repost made
Tap tweet 1 to open post detail (push transition)
Bookmark onboarding tooltip ('Save a post to read later...') fades in above the action row. It is shown automatically; the Bookmark button is never tapped.

elements.name: Heart icon (outline, unliked)
elements.notes: Post-detail size (61x53 px, stroke included). The feed icon is about 0.82x this size. Gray matches X's secondary text gray.

elements.name: Heart icon (filled, liked)
elements.notes: Post detail: 55-58 x 48-51 px depending on the antialias threshold. Feed: about 15 x 13 pt. Center stays fixed; no translation.

elements.name: Burst disc / ring
elements.notes: A circle centered on the heart. It grows, changes color, then hollows from the center into a ring that thins to about 2 pt before vanishing. Feed version: about 23 pt max diameter.

elements.name: Particles
elements.notes: 14 dots: 7 pairs spaced 360/7 = 51.4 deg apart, about 10.5 deg between the two dots in a pair. Measured pair angles (deg CCW from +x): ~26/36, 79/90, 136/147, 188/199, 237/248, 285/295, 334/345. In each pair one dot travels farther (outer); the other stays closer (inner) and fades sooner.

elements.name: Like count
elements.notes: Changes digit and color in a single frame, with no roll, slide or fade. Same in feed and detail.

elements.name: Repost action sheet
elements.notes: Bottom sheet with rows Repost / Quote / React with Video, over a black dim overlay of about 40%. Height and corner radius are rough estimates.

animations.name: Pink dot grows into burst disc
animations.easing: Strong ease-out: 50% of the size reached at about 50 ms, 86% at 100 ms. Color lags the size and moves from crimson to lavender mostly between 66 and 200 ms (sampled #DF2A67@33, #DA3E83@66, #D751A0@100, #D365BB@133, #CC8EF4@200).
animations.notes: Measured in post detail. The recording drops to about 30 fps in places, so many samples are 33 ms apart. The outline heart disappears on the same frame the dot appears; there is no press-scale before the tap.

animations.name: Disc hollows into ring and vanishes
animations.easing: Close to linear with a slight ease-in. The outer edge stays at 27-28 pt while the hole widens; the ring is gone on the 331 ms frame.
animations.notes: t_ms is measured from 10.923 s (166 ms after the tap). The first two samples are the same frame (hole just opening). At 132 ms the ring is about 1.7 pt thick.

animations.name: Filled heart pops in, dips, settles
animations.easing: Fast ease-out pop from 0.16 to 0.98 in about 150 ms (inside the ring). The heart then contracts slowly to 0.89 (minimum at about 330-430 ms after it appears) and eases back to 1.0. This reads as an underdamped settle where the rebound is a dip, not an overshoot above 1.0.
animations.notes: Scale is width / rest width (55 px), measured in post detail. Both feed likes match: ring gone at +316 ms, 0.89 dip at about +550-600 ms, settled at about +880 ms after the tap. The heart is pure #F91880 from its first visible frame and does not move.

animations.name: Particle ring burst (7 pairs)
animations.easing: Strong ease-out on radius (expo-like): about 60% of the travel happens in the first 150 ms. Dots shrink while they travel. Inner dots disappear by about 600 ms after the tap; outer dots by about 830 ms.
animations.notes: Radius is measured from the heart center to the dot centroid, for the pair at about 237/248 deg. All 14 dots launch together with no stagger. They spawn at about the disc's outer edge, at the moment the ring starts to hollow. The two dots in a pair usually have different pastel colors. Dots on the right side partly overlap the count text, so angles near 0 deg are under-sampled.

animations.name: Unlike: outline enlarges, holds, shrinks back
animations.easing: Snaps to about 1.56x within 1-2 frames and holds at 1.56-1.59x for about 130 ms. It then shrinks to 1.0 over about 150 ms with an ease-in-out (slow start, fast middle, soft landing). No burst, no particles.
animations.notes: Same profile on all three unlikes (5.943, 9.757, 11.938). The shrink always begins about 170-185 ms after the change, so it is likely a fixed keyframe hold rather than finger-down time, but this cannot be confirmed. Scale is width / rest outline width (61 px). The fill-to-outline swap and the count/color change are instant.

animations.name: Repost sheet slides up
animations.easing: ease-out (iOS sheet-like). Dim overlay reaches about 40% black by about 3.28 s.
animations.notes: Secondary interaction; measured only roughly at 1/6 scale. The dismiss at 3.98-4.13 s is a slide down in about 150 ms with the overlay fading out.

observations: This is the classic Twitter heart burst: crimson dot grows into a lavender (#CC8EF4) circle, the circle hollows into a ring, the heart pops inside, and 7 pairs of pastel confetti dots fly out. Total about 880 ms from tap to settle.
The heart never goes above 1.0. After the pop it dips to 0.89 and comes back, which gives a soft 'breathing' settle instead of an overshoot.
The like count changes number and color (gray to #F91880) on the same frame as the tap, with no number roll. This is true in the feed and in post detail.
Timing is identical in the feed (smaller icon, about 23 pt disc) and in post detail (28 pt disc). The animation appears to scale with the icon size.
Unlike has no particles or color fade. It is a quick enlarge-and-hold of the gray outline (about 1.58x) followed by a 150 ms ease-in-out shrink back.

Repost opens a bottom sheet (Repost / Quote / React with Video), which was dismissed without reposting. No bookmark tap happened; the Bookmark tooltip at about 11.95 s is an automatic onboarding hint that fades in over about 230 ms.
Video playback in the first tweet's media causes constant motion; it is unrelated to the reactions.
open_questions: The recording runs at about 30 fps during the burst (frames are duplicated), so samples are 17-33 ms apart. The exact durations of the sub-50 ms phases (dot appearance, unlike snap) are approximate.
We can't tell if the unlike enlarge-and-hold is tied to how long the finger is down; the hold length was constant (about 170-185 ms) across all three unlikes.
Particle colors are taken from antialiased 2-3 pt dots, so the exact hex values are approximate.
Haptic feedback cannot be observed from the recording.
